claim_limits: Conditional Newman et al. 2014 Table 11 rounding representation only.
No raw-data or full cryogenic torsion-pendulum estimator reproduction.
No audit of the conclusion's integer 14 ppm, 22 ppm, or 20 ppm statements; only Table 11's one-decimal quadrature sums are terminal targets.
No inference of hidden unrounded author values, historical nearest rounding, or uniqueness.
Compatible means at least one scheduled interior representation exists under the declared one-decimal rounding model.
Incompatible means not representable anywhere in the declared component rounding box under the stated Table 11 quadrature model; it is model-relative, not a statement of physical impossibility.
Unresolved is schedule-relative even under the richer tensor grid.
No discrepancy cause, sampling model, p-value, likelihood, or probability is established.
No comparison of measured central G values with HUST, Schlamminger, CODATA, or any external reference.
No common-cause, common-constant, universality, or cross-measurement estimator claim.
No update to the PR #41 joint representation object in this PR.
No E-001 artifact is an input or dependency.

classification.compatible: At least one frozen interior tensor-grid point has exact squared uncertainty strictly inside the terminal rounding interval squared.
classification.incompatible: The guaranteed exact squared-uncertainty enclosure over the entire declared component box is disjoint from the closed squared terminal interval.
classification.invalid: Malformed, missing, or provenance-invalid evidence raises and never becomes a numerical verdict.
classification.unresolved: The guaranteed enclosure overlaps the terminal interval but none of the frozen tensor-grid candidates supplies a witness; schedule-relative, not publication-relative.

epistemic_routing.DM-051: Joint-inference negative-label maintenance is not on this PR's dependency surface; this new certificate nevertheless uses an explicitly model-relative negative label.
epistemic_routing.DM-053: The third publication is not joined to the cross-measurement conjunction in this PR, so the joint-artifact resolution-caveat promotion condition does not fire here.
epistemic_routing.E-001: Must remain structurally outside imports, filesystem inputs, source projections, and claims.
epistemic_routing.FH-2: Handled prospectively by a 3375-point per-scope independent tensor grid; unresolved remains explicitly schedule-relative.

rounding_policy.bin_interpretation: Printed one-decimal cells denote closed rounding bins for conservative enclosure; witnesses must use strict interior component values and land strictly inside nondegenerate terminal bins.

candidates.reason: Table 11 gives three named uncertainty components and a printed quadrature sum for each of three fibre results; surrounding text states quadrature combination; one paper supplies all required numerical and semantic inputs.

Primary measurement and companion uncertainty discussion are available, but Newman offers a cleaner same-table three-scope reconstruction for the first real falsification attempt. No arithmetic outcome was used in this ordering.

criteria: numerical table directly accessible for independent transcription
explicit component inventory and printed aggregate in same publication
declared aggregation semantics sufficient for an exact bounded reconstruction
candidate chosen without pre-checking rounding-consistency outcome
selection.selection_time_semantics: Source feasibility and table structure examined before freeze; no RSS, interval-overlap, witness, or terminal classification calculation performed before freeze.

limitations: Hashes bind the frozen source projection and attestation bytes, not automatic comprehension of an external publication.
CI performs no live source download.
No raw-data, estimator, fibre-correlation, or final integer-ppm uncertainty reconstruction is claimed.

semantics.audit_total_rule: For each fibre separately, Table 11 labels the terminal row 'quadrature sum'; surrounding text says statistical, systematic, and analysis-method contributions and their quadrature sum are assigned.
semantics.final_integer_ppm_statements: Outside this audit; the paper's conclusion gives 14, 22, and 20 ppm, but this certificate targets Table 11's 14.5, 22.2, and 19.6 only.
semantics.rounding_resolution: All audited Table 11 component and terminal cells are printed to one decimal place.
semantics.scope_relationship: Three separate mandatory fibre audits; no averaging or cross-fibre covariance model.
